test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are seven friends sitting in a single row facing North. S is to the immediate right of R. T and P are neighbours of U.Q is to the immediate left of R and on second place from left most end. P is at the right most end. Who is sitting on the immediate left of S?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V.

S is to the immediate right of R.

T and P are neighbours of U.

Q is to the immediate left of R and on second place from left most end.

P is at the right most end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eb2ccd1ed4f6b75994ed535a1fdedf5fe07570e879b2bbd920cce03c314a634.png] 

So, **R** is sitting on the immediate left of S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**
